title: Practice the rook's straight move.
goal: Move your rook from the square a1 to the square a5 in one move.
narration_seed: A rook moves straight across a row or up and down a column when nothing blocks it.
hints: Move the rook straight upward through the empty column from the square a1.
solution_text: Move your rook from the square a1 to the square a5.
success_text: You moved your rook to the square a5.
failure_text: Choose a square in the same vertical column as the square a1.
